# Vendored Frontend Libraries

Place the following un-minified or minified files here:

- `alpine.min.js`    — Alpine.js 3.x (https://github.com/alpinejs/alpine)
- `ag-grid.min.js`   — AG Grid Community (https://www.ag-grid.com)
- `xlsx.min.js`      — SheetJS (https://sheetjs.com)
- `qrcode.min.js`    — qrcode.js (https://github.com/davidshimjs/qrcodejs)

The panel loads these from `/assets/js/vendor/` at runtime. No CDN is used.
